Match Card Options

Three new directions for the Find Your Match card, each drawn with real tiles, mats and racks from the app on three of your combos. Pick the one you want, or mix them: for example, close-up bands for the Table view and the spread for the love triangle.

A · Close-up bandsB · The spreadC · Showcase
Option A

Close-up bands

Your idea for the Table view: three zoomed-in bands stacked like a spliced screenshot. Tiles on top, a close-up of the mat filling the middle, racks laid out flat on the bottom. Every item gets a real look at its colors.

Option B

The spread

The love-triangle view, opened up. The mat is the hero, the tile pile sits big and out to the right, the racks sit out to the left, and the names move into small tags on the pictures so there is less text.

Facebook post (4:5)

Option C

Showcase

The full mat and a tile close-up side by side, with the racks laid out wide underneath. Good for a shopping view: every piece is big and has its brand logo.
